summary: The Duzzy Bat (calm: the Cozy Bat), Crystal Cavern's recurring chaos bat: a 2x2 body sheet (chaos idle hovering with purple spiral eyes and bubbles; burst fluttering with wind wisps; soothed curled cozy with wings folded; calm perched and waving one wing), drawn to the owner's critter concept sheet.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini from the owner's critter concept sheet for the watercolour style and swirly chaos eyes, and art-teacher's flat green body sheet as the clean #00FF00 key reference.

edits.prompt: A 2x2 character sheet of an adorable chubby pastel lavender-plum fruit bat with fluffy cream tummy, floppy ears, yellow star bandana, rosy cheeks, thin warm-brown ink outlines, and four poses (chaos idle, chaos burst, soothed, calm idle) on flat pure green #00FF00.
edits.note: Kept as generated: four whole figures on a clean flat green key with zero green on the bat.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-person.ts bat --key=#00FF00 --height=330. Keys green, drops detached islands under 120 px, despills the alpha edge, scales chaos idle to 330 px, and adds the shared chaos aura.

measuredCentres.bodyCentreMethod: mean opaque-pixel centroid across the four generated body frames
